title: Changing or cancelling an appointment
summary: Move an existing booking, handle a full day, cancel, or just check the time and address.

hello.speaker: Receptionist
hello.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn yǒu shénme shì?
hello.en: Hello, what can I do for you?

rephrase.pinyin: Nín dǎ diànhuà yǒu shénme xūyào?

choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎi yíxià yùyuē shíjiān.
choices.en: I'd like to change my appointment time
I'd like to cancel my appointment

choices.zh: 我想确认一下我的预约。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng quèrèn yíxià wǒ de yùyuē.
choices.en: I'd like to check my appointment

lookup.speaker: Receptionist
lookup.zh: 好的，您叫什么名字？原来约的是几点？
lookup.pinyin: Hǎo de, nín jiào shénme míngzi? Yuánlái yuē de shì jǐ diǎn?
lookup.en: Sure. What's your name, and what time was it originally?

rephrase.zh: 请告诉我您的名字和原来的预约时间。
rephrase.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nín de míngzi hé yuánlái de yùyuē shíjiān.
rephrase.en: Please tell me your name and the original appointment time.

choices.zh: 我叫李明，原来是明天下午两点。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng, yuánlái shì míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn.
choices.en: I'm Li Ming — it was tomorrow at 2 p.m.

choices.pinyin: Shíjiān wǒ wàng le, wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng.
choices.en: I've forgotten the time — my name is Li Ming

found.speaker: Receptionist
found.pinyin: Zhǎodào le, míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn.

choices.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng gǎi ge shíjiān.
choices.en: Yes — I'd like to change it

new-time.speaker: Receptionist
new-time.pinyin: Nín xiǎng gǎi dào shénme shíhou?
new-time.en: When would you like to move it to?

rephrase.pinyin: Nín xiǎng huàn dào nǎ yì tiān, jǐ diǎn?
rephrase.en: Which day and time would you like instead?

choices.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī nǎ tiān yǒu kòng?
choices.en: Which days are free next week?

choices.pinyin: Tóng yì tiān wǎn yìdiǎn ne?
choices.en: What about later the same day?

friday.speaker: Receptionist
friday.zh: 星期五上午约满了，下午三点可以。
friday.pinyin: Xīngqīwǔ shàngwǔ yuē mǎn le, xiàwǔ sān diǎn kěyǐ.
friday.en: Friday morning is full, but 3 p.m. works.

variants.pinyin: Nà tiān shàngwǔ méiyǒu wèizi le.
variants.en: There are no morning slots that day.

next-week.speaker: Receptionist
next-week.zh: 下星期一和星期三都有空，上午下午都行。
next-week.pinyin: Xià xīngqīyī hé xīngqīsān dōu yǒu kòng, shàngwǔ xiàwǔ dōu xíng.
next-week.en: Next Monday and Wednesday are both open, morning or afternoon.

same-day.speaker: Receptionist
same-day.zh: 明天五点还有一个空位。
same-day.pinyin: Míngtiān wǔ diǎn hái yǒu yí ge kòngwèi.
same-day.en: There's one opening tomorrow at five.

choices.pinyin: Tài wǎn le, nà xià ge xīngqī ne?
choices.en: Too late — what about next week?

cancel-name.speaker: Receptionist
cancel-name.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn nín de míngzi?
cancel-name.en: Okay, may I have your name?

cancel-offer.speaker: Receptionist
cancel-offer.zh: 找到了。要不要帮您改到别的时间，而不是取消？
cancel-offer.pinyin: Zhǎodào le. Yào bu yào bāng nín gǎi dào bié de shíjiān, ér bú shì qǔxiāo?
cancel-offer.en: Found it. Would you like to move it to another time instead of cancelling?

rephrase.zh: 您可以不取消，换一个时间，要吗？
rephrase.pinyin: Nín kěyǐ bù qǔxiāo, huàn yí ge shíjiān, yào ma?
rephrase.en: Instead of cancelling you could pick another time — would you like that?

choices.pinyin: Yě hǎo, nà gǎi ge shíjiān ba.
choices.en: Good idea — let's change the time

fee.speaker: Receptionist
fee.zh: 提前二十四小时取消不收费。
fee.pinyin: Tíqián èrshísì xiǎoshí qǔxiāo bù shōufèi.
fee.en: There's no charge if you cancel 24 hours ahead.

choices.pinyin: Nà wǒ háishi gǎi ge shíjiān ba.
choices.en: Then I'll change the time instead

check-name.speaker: Receptionist
check-name.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn nín de míngzi?
check-name.en: Okay, may I have your name?

check-found.speaker: Receptionist
check-found.zh: 李明，明天下午两点，没错。
check-found.pinyin: Lǐ Míng, míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, méi cuò.
check-found.en: Li Ming, tomorrow at 2 p.m. — that's right.

choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎi dào bié de shíjiān.
choices.en: I'd like to move it to another time

changed-end.speaker: Receptionist
changed-end.zh: 好的，已经帮您改好了，我会发短信确认。
changed-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, yǐjīng bāng nín gǎi hǎo le, wǒ huì fā duǎnxìn quèrèn.
changed-end.en: Done — I've changed it and will text you a confirmation.

cancelled-end.speaker: Receptionist
cancelled-end.zh: 好的，已经取消了。需要的话随时再约。
cancelled-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, yǐjīng qǔxiāo le. Xūyào de huà suíshí zài yuē.
cancelled-end.en: Okay, it's cancelled. Book again whenever you need.

address-end.speaker: Receptionist
address-end.zh: 在中山路八十八号三楼，我发到您手机上。
address-end.pinyin: Zài Zhōngshān Lù bāshíbā hào sān lóu, wǒ fā dào nín shǒujī shang.
address-end.en: 88 Zhongshan Road, third floor. I'll send it to your phone.
address-end.outcome: You have the time and the address.
